mentions.name: Realistic surfing game
mentions.description: This is a (somewhat) realistic surfing game built in Unity/C# that focuses on realistic breaking waves, speed generation, and carving rather than arcade-style impossible air combos. After a year of development, a demo is planned to gather feedback and gauge whether there is enough traction to work toward a Steam release.
mentions.problem: Existing surfing games are arcade-style and not close to the real sport.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a (somewhat) realistic surfing game. Tired of arcade-style games, I decided to try my hand at something closer to the real sport, focusing on realistic breaking waves, speed generation and carving, rather than impossible air combos.
